description: This OpenDOSM dataset gives the share of households in each Malaysian state and administrative district with piped water at home, covered by sanitary latrines, and with electricity at home. It is produced by the Department of Statistics Malaysia from the household-level Household Income and Expenditure Survey, which runs at least twice in every five years, and holds 172 rows per round for 2016, 2019, 2022 and 2024, covering 16 states and 160 districts. The catalogue page was last updated on 3 August 2026. The same portal carries the census-based count of households and living quarters by state, whose census years 1970 to 2020 come from adjusted population census data and whose other years are estimates. Format and access: CSV and Parquet downloads and the data.gov.my Open API, free and without registration. Licence: CC BY 4.0, free. Caveats: the figures are survey estimates, not census counts, so small districts carry sampling error, and census small-area housing tables are not on the portal; the page links technical notes on sampling. Simulation uses: district service coverage gaps for water, sanitation and electricity planning, and for weighting exposure and vulnerability. Related records: the OpenDOSM water supply statistics and IPUMS International.
